description:
Step aboard the Northern Lights for an immersive 60 or 90-minute sightseeing adventure across Boston Harbor. Explore the harbor's rich and fascinating history, guaranteed to captivate your attention throughout the journey. Take in the sights from the comfort of our cozy  main cabin, complete with heating or air conditioning for your comfort. Alternatively, venture outside to our open-air covered top deck to bask in the fresh sea breeze and marvel at the harbor's beauty.

While aboard, satisfy your cravings with a selection of drinks and small bites available for purchase from our onboard bar. Whether you're a history enthusiast, a nature lover, or simply seeking a relaxing cruise, our sightseeing experience aboard the Northern Lights promises to be unforgettable. This cruise is moderately narrated by the Captain. Enjoy commentary on the main sights as we cruise. Please note this is not a fully narrated tour. 

#Notable sites:
* Great for getting perfect Boston Skyline pictures
* View the steeple of the Old North Church, Bunker Hill Monument, USS Cassin Young, and the USS Constitution
* Pass by Fort Independence and take in views of Boston's Seaport District 
* See Spectacle Island, which has been transformed by the Big Dig Project of Boston 

During the month of December we operator our Cocoa & Carols Cruise during the afternoon. Click [here](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/boston-sailing/items/32749/?full-items=yes&flow=269876) to check availability!

##About Northern Lights  
A Coast Guard Certified Captains and extremely friendly and knowledgeable crew who are trained to help in the event of an emergency operate Northern Lights. The motor yacht Northern Lights is stylized after the classic New England 1920s style steamships. She is one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels in Boston Harbor. Northern Lights is 115-feet in length, features six bathrooms, and provides ample seating throughout the ship for up to 149 passengers. She is built for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures. Thus, she is excellent for taking out groups of friends and family to see the harbor. Sit back and relax in our climate-controlled (heating and air conditioning) cabin or enjoy the sea breeze on our open top deck. Be sure to visit our fully stocked bar on the main deck to purchase refreshments.
